intent: New recurring monthly post type: Monthly Questions Overview — a high-level picture of Dáil Parliamentary Questions asked and answered in the previous month. One of three new monthly post types (with Monthly Speeches Overview and Monthly Bill Summary). Discovery phase complete; content spec agreed with Warren; visual direction (option B, colored bars + legend, 3-col/2-row) picked by Warren; full 7-slide carousel now built and rendering, blocked on a fewest_askers design decision before final approval.
data_sources: silver_questions (batch copy) — coverage Feb 2025 to 2026-07-28; no August 2026 data in production (confirmed again 2026-09-22, run 35796492112)

written_question_answer_sections / written_question_answer_bridge — contract-approved (configs/political_metrics/written_question_answers.yml) but NOT present in the current production batch (confirmed 2026-09-22, run 35795811070: botocore NoSuchKey); loaded optionally, with the 'answers' slide degrading to a placeholder when absent

decisions.question: Content idea (§6.1 gate 1)
decisions.choice: Monthly Questions Overview, re-rendered monthly for the last completed month
decisions.rationale: Warren's request; supported by existing questions metrics layer and written-answer foundations

decisions.question: Test month
decisions.choice: July 2026
decisions.rationale: August 2026 absent from production batch; July is the latest full month available

decisions.question: Slide list
decisions.choice: Headline stats; Top 10 askers; Fewest 10 askers; Party questions per TD; Departments asked; Answers and referrals; Methodology/sources
decisions.rationale: Agreed after July data review

decisions.question: Constituency slide
decisions.choice: Dropped
decisions.rationale: July per-TD constituency ranking driven by single TDs (e.g. Cork North-Central 418 of 918 from one TD); duplicates top-askers slide

decisions.question: Oral questions and office-holders asking
decisions.choice: Folded into notes on other slides, not their own slides
decisions.rationale: Oral under 2% of July questions; 32 of 40 office-holders asked none

decisions.question: Fewest-questions slide eligibility
decisions.choice: Exclude office-holders (from silver_member_offices), party leaders (hand-maintained config list), and TDs not seated for the full month
decisions.rationale: These groups structurally do not use PQs; including them would be misleading
decisions.status: NOT YET BUILT as of the 2026-09-22 full-carousel build — no office-holder/party-leader reference list exists anywhere in the pipeline (confirmed by search); a caveat was substituted instead. See the 2026-09-22 'Issue found' decision below for why this now needs Warren's input rather than staying a caveat.

decisions.question: Fewest-questions period
decisions.choice: Single month (not rolling 3-month)
decisions.rationale: Warren: absences should be documented as data; he will add absence data later. Ignore absences for now; covered by caveat.

decisions.question: Fewest-questions comparison
decisions.choice: Show gap from the median of eligible TDs, labelled 'typical TD'
decisions.rationale: Mean (~66 in July) is inflated by a few very heavy askers; median (~40) is robust
decisions.status: NOT YET BUILT as of the 2026-09-22 full-carousel build — the slide as built is a plain ascending ranking of raw counts, no median comparison. See the 2026-09-22 'Issue found' decision below.

decisions.question: Fewest-questions tone
decisions.choice: Direct, named ranking with neutral factual title ('Fewest questions submitted'); no effort-characterising language; caveat in description or final slide
decisions.rationale: Warren wants to call out low askers; semantics.md requires neutral, factual framing

decisions.question: Party comparison
decisions.choice: Questions per TD (non-office TDs), alongside totals
decisions.rationale: Raw totals reflect party size (catalogue caveat)

decisions.question: Who is asked most
decisions.choice: Departments (question recipient labels, mapped to display names), with answering minister as subtitle
decisions.rationale: Some ministers hold two portfolios, so person and department rankings differ
decisions.status: Built without the answering-minister subtitle (not yet needed/available in a display-name-mapped form) — departments slide uses recipient labels straight from the source record.

decisions.question: Duplicate question_id handling (§6.1 gate 3 build)
decisions.choice: Dedupe silver_questions on question_id (keep first occurrence) before eligibility/ranking, rather than hard-failing like process/political_metrics_question_commission.py does
decisions.rationale: Warren: dedupe and record the count — a recurring monthly post can't hard-fail on a source data-quality issue it doesn't control; the exact counts are written to the run's run_manifest.json (data_quality.question_dedupe) for the record

decisions.question: Prototype scope (§6.1 gate 2 — visual options)
decisions.choice: Build only the 'Most questions submitted' (top 10 TDs) slide first as instagram/projects/pq_monthly_overview_v1/, reusing horizontal_bar.py and title_text_media_v1.json unmodified; get Warren's visual-direction decision before building the other six slides
decisions.rationale: workflows_v1.md §6.1 step 4 — prototype ONE representative slide before scaling to a full carousel (the Bill Tracker lesson)

decisions.question: Label-overlap defect on the first prototype
decisions.choice: Warren confirmed the assessment (3-line-wrap 'Name (Party)' labels overlapping neighbouring rows) and asked for two comparable fixes to be built and rendered side by side rather than picking one blind
decisions.rationale: Warren's own words: try a party-acronym label ('Name (XX)') as one option, and colored bars by party with a legend as a second option

decisions.question: Visual-direction option A implementation
decisions.choice: top_askers_v1_acronym — horizontal_bar.py used completely unmodified (frozen file, never touched); label format changed from 'Name (Party)' to 'Name (XX)' using a 2-4 letter party acronym
decisions.rationale: Shortening the label directly fixes the wrap/overlap without touching any frozen renderer code

decisions.question: Visual-direction option B implementation
decisions.choice: top_askers_v2_colored_legend — new instagram/visuals/renderers/horizontal_bar_grouped.py module (not frozen, project-owned) that imports horizontal_bar.py's proven label-wrap/clip helpers unchanged and adds per-bar color-by-party plus a legend
decisions.rationale: horizontal_bar.py is in the CI-frozen v1 file set (byte-identity-checked against 386b933) and can't be edited for a one-off feature; a new sibling module that reuses its internals avoids duplicating proven logic while adding what it doesn't do

decisions.question: Option B color palette
decisions.choice: Anthropic dataviz skill's validated default categorical palette (dark-mode steps), colors are abstract per-party identity slots — not official party brand colors — with a legend + value labels as the required secondary encoding
decisions.rationale: Ran the skill's validate_palette.js against the project's actual #0f2f24 chart background: ALL CHECKS PASS with one WARN (green slot contrast, 2.92:1), mitigated per the skill's own rule by the always-present value labels and legend text

decisions.question: instagram_factory_render.yml changes made along the way (2026-09-21)
decisions.choice: Edited three times (existing file, not first appearance, so within normal Director authority): (1) inject any new instagram/visuals/renderers/*.py file the project adds, not just the fixed party_issue_monthly_profile_v2-era file list; (2) capture the render step's stdout/stderr and push it to director/sessions/<id>/runs/<run_id>-render-output.log so failures are debuggable (GitHub's own log-download endpoint isn't reachable from this environment's network); (3) also push the adapter's run_manifest.json to director/sessions/<id>/runs/<run_id>-run-manifest.json so per-run detail (like the dedupe count) is readable without the 30-day Actions artifact
decisions.rationale: First attempt at the two-variant render failed with an ImportError because the injection step didn't know about the new renderer module; without the diagnostics log the second failure (a legend clipping the figure) would have been a black box

decisions.question: Visual-direction pick (§6.1 gate — Warren's call)
decisions.choice: Option B (colored bars by party + legend), with one modification: legend laid out as 3 columns x 2 rows instead of 2 columns x 3 rows, and the chart enlarged into the vertical space the shorter legend frees up
decisions.rationale: Warren's own words: 'I prefer option B. One modification should be that instead of two columns of three rows for the legend, make it three columns, two rows, and fill in the remaining space by making the chart slightly larger.'

decisions.question: Option B legend/chart tuning for the 3-col/2-row layout
decisions.choice: horizontal_bar_grouped.py: LEGEND_MAX_COLUMNS 2 -> 3; PLOT_HEIGHT 0.66 -> 0.70 (legend band 0.185 -> 0.16 figure-fraction gap, still ample for 2 rows given the old 3-row layout fit comfortably in a similar-sized band); LEGEND_MAX_LABEL_CHARS 18 -> 13 and column/handle spacing trimmed, since 3 columns leaves less horizontal room per column on the 1032px canvas than 2 did
decisions.rationale: 3 columns needs less vertical room (2 rows vs 3) but more horizontal room per row than 2 columns did on the same canvas width — tightened the horizontal safety margins (which is what actually caused the earlier legend_clipped_to_figure failure at ncol=4) rather than the vertical ones

decisions.question: Proceed to remaining six slides (Warren's call)
decisions.choice: "leave as is for the dedupes. We can investigate that in the future. It's not a big enough proportion to be concerned about. Let's proceed now to the other slides."
decisions.rationale: Warren's explicit instruction, authorizing the full 7-slide build using the settled top_askers visual treatment

decisions.question: New text-only layout for headline/methodology/answers-placeholder
decisions.choice: instagram/templates/layouts/text_block_v1.json — title + 6 independently-bound text-line placeholders + footer, non-frozen (instagram/templates/layouts/*.json is confirmed NOT part of the CI-frozen v1 file set)
decisions.rationale: template_renderer.py's text_lines() collapses embedded newlines within a single placeholder's text, so a multi-line stat block needs one placeholder per line rather than one placeholder with \n\n separators

decisions.question: Answer-tables missing from current production batch
decisions.choice: Load written_question_answer_sections/written_question_answer_bridge in a separate try/except-wrapped call, outside project.yml's hard required_tables; degrade the 'answers' slide to an honest text placeholder (no fabricated figures) when the load fails, rather than aborting the whole 7-slide render
decisions.rationale: Run 35795811070 failed with botocore NoSuchKey — the tables are contract-approved (configs/political_metrics/written_question_answers.yml) but not present in the current production batch (written-pq-answers-20260905-1), confirming director/data_products.yml's known_drift_fact caveat that batch/table availability isn't guaranteed across time even for approved contracts

decisions.question: instagram_factory_render.yml changes made this build (2026-09-22)
decisions.choice: Edited again (existing file, not first appearance): inject any project-added instagram/templates/layouts/*.json file that doesn't already exist in the pinned worktree, mirroring the existing pattern for extra renderer modules
decisions.rationale: Run 35796641892 failed with FileNotFoundError on text_block_v1.json — the injection step had no equivalent for new (non-frozen) template layout files, only for renderer modules

decisions.question: Verification-render period override
decisions.choice: Dispatched with an explicit period: "2026-07" instead of the project default last_completed_month
decisions.rationale: Run 35796492112 confirmed (again) that August 2026 is not yet in production data — last_completed_month resolves to August given today's date (2026-09-22), which is a real data gap, not a code bug; July is the same month already analyzed and shown to Warren, so it's the right month for verifying the carousel renders correctly. This is a one-off dispatch parameter for THIS verification, not a change to the project's default period behavior (which should still correctly use last_completed_month once August data is in production).

decisions.question: Issue found: fewest_askers has no usable content for July 2026 (and likely most months)
decisions.choice: NOT resolved unilaterally — flagged to Warren rather than silently redesigned or routed around
decisions.rationale: All 10 of July's lowest-count eligible TDs asked exactly zero questions (Alan Dillon, Charlie McConalogue, Colm Brophy, Dara Calleary, Darragh O'Brien, Emer Higgins, Helen McEntee, Hildegarde Naughton, Jack Chambers, James Browne — all read as office-holders/senior figures, consistent with the discovery-phase finding that 32 of 40 office-holders asked none). A plain ascending bar chart has nothing to show when every bar is zero-length; the frozen horizontal_bar.py renderer additionally can't distinguish this from 'no data' (empty_state = not clean_rows or max(values) <= 0) and shows a 'No data available' placeholder instead. This traces back to the originally agreed office-holder-exclusion + median-comparison design for this slide never having been built (only a caveat was substituted, since no office-holder/party-leader reference list exists in the pipeline) — that gap is now a real content problem, not just a caveat, since the pattern looks likely to recur most months. Options for Warren to choose from: (a) build the office-holder/party-leader exclusion from a hand-maintained list Warren supplies, restoring the original design; (b) render this case as a text slide (names only) when there's a mass zero-tie; (c) show only the non-zero low askers, if any exist that month; (d) something else. This is the content-idea/visual-direction gate (workflows_v1.md §6.1) — Warren's call, not the Director's.
